disclosures.title: ChatGPT Pro Premium — Shared Account Disclaimer

sections.heading: Account Ownership
sections.content: This is a SHARED account managed by AI Team Premium. You do not own the account. Access may be revoked at any time.

sections.heading: Device Restrictions
sections.content: Shared accounts typically restrict usage to 1-2 devices. Logging in on additional devices may trigger account locks or bans.

sections.heading: Content Guidelines
sections.content: OpenAI's content policy applies. Violation may result in account ban, affecting all users on the shared seat.

sections.heading: Warranty & Refunds
sections.content: Full refund within 30 days if unused or misused. After 30 days, service continues as-is. No refunds after initial commitment.

sections.heading: Service Level Agreement
sections.content: Best-effort delivery within 5-15 minutes. No guaranteed uptime for shared accounts.

sections.heading: Automatic Renewal
sections.content: Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing period. You can cancel anytime from your CapCut account settings.

sections.heading: Pricing Verification
sections.content: Prices shown are estimates. Actual in-app pricing may vary by region and promotion. Verify current prices before purchase.

sections.heading: Local Payment Methods
sections.content: We accept bKash, Nagad, and Bank Transfer in Bangladesh. Payment details are confirmed at proposal stage.

sections.heading: Terms of Use
sections.content: CapCut's user agreement applies. We are not affiliated with ByteDance or CapCut.

shared-account-disclosure.title: Important: Shared Account Terms
shared-account-disclosure.text: Shared accounts are managed by AI Team Premium and may have usage restrictions. Single-device login is required. Account access may be revoked without notice if terms are violated.
